summary: Amendment items 6 and 7. Skills CAM acquires from its own executed traces now validate and are reused (before: every induce in every run failed validation - stale observation ids, refs made parameters); learned applicability, composition, discovery of recurring procedures, refinement by experience; no false success. Goal-free mode's expected transferable competence is learned from later assigned objectives (was the constant 1.0). Agent hooks SG-1..3 for ST. See docs/SG.md for the four evidence levels per capability.

CU-15.changed: skills from the agent's own grounded browser traces become re-executable (role/name locators), skill.discover mines recurring procedures
CU-15.still_fails: no skill acquired in the real configuration (the agent produced no verified-progress trace); layout B: an asynchronous effect is not observable, no skill registered

CU-16.changed: tentative single-example conditions tested by validation; content-only text conditions (no false success); reusable portion of noisy traces
CU-16.still_fails: postcondition inference is a rule over the observation format

CU-17.changed: parameters from one trace (what flows into the result), enum domains from options and from peer elements, reuse on an unseen path, composition
CU-17.still_fails: no transfer to a different interface (layout B): a new skill is needed

CU-18.changed: learned applicability (probit ADF) gates runs only when confident; precondition failures teach applicability; refinement drops needless steps after successes
CU-18.still_fails: applicability never refused a run in the real-configuration runs (too few runs)

CU-33.changed: primitive-only vs acquired skills measured on browser tasks (success, decisions, primitive operations, latency, unseen path, changed interface); real configuration skills vs primitive arm
CU-33.still_fails: real configuration: the skills arm acquired no skill (no verified progress in 32 decisions); the primitive-only arm was not run (GPU queue); comparison measured in the controlled setting only

AE-04.changed: expected transferable competence learned from later assigned objectives (was 1.0)
AE-04.still_fails: usefulness not shown: LabWorld ablation paired difference -4.6 adopters [-10.6, +1.9] (no improvement); real configuration: floor (no objective achieved in either arm)
